name: check_diagram_placement
description: Calculate print consequences without editing. Supply kind graph/ratio-table/value-graph/cuboids/number-line/venn/algebra-grid/bar-model, the exact returned envelope, and positive widthMm and/or heightMm. One dimension derives the other; two define a box and report a proportional fit. Warnings describe reduction or stretching; no universal minimum or booklet fit is assumed. effectivePngDpi concerns PNG only. Venn outputView:pupil|answer selects artwork while retaining pupil source. No baseHash is needed. Use when considering a resize, not at every native-size placement.

name: create_algebra_grid
description: Create expanding/factorising multiplication grids with internal lines only. Supply exact envelope OR spec:{example?,rowCount?,columnCount?,cellMm?,settings?,cells?}. Counts2..7 include headings; default blank3x3. Examples single,double,signed,cubic,factor,negative,common,source-expand,source-factor preserve pupil blanks. Settings: mode:expand|factorise,expression,questionVisible,gridVisible,answerLines:0..3,compactHeadings,gridLineMm:0.35|0.5|0.79375,paper:A4|A3,orientation:portrait|landscape,intentionalError. cells:[{rowId,columnId,value:string|null,hidden?}],initial IDs r0/c0 etc. Product cells12..18mm,default15. Null is blank;zero is not blank. Never infer answers. Returns preview,outlined SVG,verified600ppi PNG,JSON,hash,physicalSizeCm and bounded editor link. Editable files/links retain hidden answers.

name: create_bar_model
description: For horizontal working fractions and handwriting space use explicit spec.schemaVersion:3; same v2 fields plus captions[].format:maths(default)|plain, minimum barHeightMm8..24. Maths a/b supports simple atoms or one parenthesised group, never nested fractions; ambiguity fails. Every explicit line reserves12mm above/3mm below its0.25mm underline,8mm long; inside lines produce uniform actual bars>=20mm. See capabilities.v3 complete schemas. Existing v1/v2 rendering remains frozen. For the improved layout explicitly supply spec:{schemaVersion:2,starter:part-whole|comparison|equal-sections|inline-ratio,count?,ratio?:positive-integer-array,partitioned?,comparisonLengths?:[longer,shorter],bars?,annotations?,captions?,title?,presentation?}. See capabilities.v2.specSchema for complete strict nested fields. V2 parts have labels:{inside,above?,below?} and fill:none|neutral|blue|green|amber; each label is {text,state}. annotations:[{id,scope:{kind:whole,barId}|{kind:range,from,to},label,decoration:none|brace|dimension,placement:above|below|inside|between}]. Whole scope follows a bar; fixed endpoints stay fixed. Captions:{id,label,alignment:left|centre|right},max3; title is a label. Output grey/colour is saved. Bare requests and legacy specs remain v1; never mix v1 fields with schemaVersion:2. Create editable Bar modelling resources. Supply spec OR exact envelope, never both. spec:{example?:BM01..BM09|H07|H18|source-sharing,worked?:false,bars?,spans?,presentation?}; example and custom bars/spans are mutually exclusive. Omit for BM01 unworked sharing64 in3:5. bars:[{id,name:{text,state},offset:numeric-string,parts:[{id,weight:positive-numeric-string,label:{text,state},shade:boolean}]}]. spans:[{id,from:{barId,partId,edge:start|end},to:{barId,partId,edge},label:{text,state},side:above|below,style:brace|dimension}]. Labels state:value|blank|question|line|hidden; hidden retains text. Shared presentation:{unitMm:4..16,barHeightMm:8..16,fontPt:10..14,nameWidthMm:20..60}. Up to6bars,24parts/bar,96parts,18spans,32KiB. Exact geometry fractions/decimals,algebra labels never evaluated. Whole/share/difference braces anchor actual boundaries. No automatic calculation. Returns canonical envelope/hash,preview,SVG,600ppiPNG,JSON,versions,native size,print facts,bounded editor link and warnings. Editable files/links retain hidden answers; pupil output default.

name: create_cuboid
description: Create one to three cuboids, cubes, cube grids or separated layers. Use spec.shapes with dimensions:{width,depth,height}, unit, labels and presentation; omitted shape fields use unworked defaults. Or supply an existing envelope, never both. New requests use cuboids-2; older envelopes retain their version. Rendering crops around actual artwork at unchanged scale. Large layer/cube combinations may exceed service print limits. Return a preview, SVG, verified 600 ppi PNG, editable JSON, contentHash, actual physicalSizeCm and an editor link where bounded. Preserve pupil blanks/hidden answers and retain the returned envelope/hash. Numeric mathematical values are strings. Never infer answers.

name: create_graph
description: Create a coordinate graph using points, segments or straight lines. Supply exact square counts and scales. Fractions such as 1/2 are supported. Keep equationVisible false unless the user explicitly requests a printed equation label; plotting y = 2x + 1 alone should return an unlabelled line. Returns image preview, editable document and download/editor links. Not for curves or arbitrary code.

equationVisible.description: Print the equation on the diagram only when the user explicitly asks to show or label it. Plotting an equation alone does not request a printed label. Default false.

name: create_number_line
description: Create an examination number line. Supply spec:{axis?,solution?,teaching?,widthCm?} or an existing envelope. axis has minimum,maximum,step numeric strings; solution is null, interval, ray or points with stable IDs. Preserve solutionVisible, tick-label answer lines, prompt and answer visibility. Omit both for a blank -5..5 axis. Return a preview, SVG, verified 600 ppi PNG, editable JSON, contentHash, actual physicalSizeCm and an editor link where bounded. Preserve pupil blanks/hidden answers and retain the returned envelope/hash. Numeric mathematical values are strings. Never infer answers.

name: create_ratio_table
description: Create a lesson-style ratio table with 1–6 rows and 1–3 columns. Use schemaVersion 1 for two columns with at least two rows; use schemaVersion 2 for one row, one column or three columns. Each row needs one explicit cell state per column: number with string value, empty, or answer-line. IDs are generated row-1, row-2, etc. Use explicit IDs for scaling transitions between adjacent rows. One operation applies to every column. Preserve unanswered cells even if their answer is calculable. Set mode annotated to show curved arrows and factor labels; simple hides annotations. Returns preview, PNG/SVG/JSON, contentHash and editable website link.

name: create_value_graph
description: Create a table of values and exam grid. Omit envelope for the June 2018 scaffold with five blank y cells and no plotted work. Supply a full schemaVersion 1 / rendererVersion value-graph-1 / styleProfile exam-v1 envelope to customize. Numeric data are strings, including fractions. Columns have id,x,y:{kind:blank|answer-line} or y:{kind:value,value:string}. Preserve pupil blanks. A curve is an explicit graph.curves object with id,equation:{a,b,c},min,max; straight joins are a series.connection, never a quadratic curve. Returns real SVG/600 ppi PNG/JSON, hash and editable link.

name: create_venn
description: Create editable one/two/three-set Venn diagrams. Supply spec with sets,shape,arrangement,widthCm,fontPt,labels:[{set,label}],definitions:[{set,text}],regions:[{mask,region}],showDefinitions,caption; or an existing envelope, never both. Region mask0 is outside; bits A=1 B=2 C=4. arrangements overlap/separate/b-inside-a/a-inside-b (non-overlap only two sets). Region kind and show/hidden/line visibility are explicit; zero is not blank. outputView defaults pupil; answer must be explicitly requested. Returned JSON/editor source always preserves pupil visibility and can include hidden answers. Return a preview, SVG, verified 600 ppi PNG, editable JSON, contentHash, actual physicalSizeCm and an editor link where bounded. Preserve pupil blanks/hidden answers and retain the returned envelope/hash. Numeric mathematical values are strings. Never infer answers.

name: download_diagram_bundle
description: Optionally download one existing diagram as ZIP containing editable JSON, outlined SVG, verified 600 ppi PNG, print facts and README. Supply kind graph/ratio-table/value-graph/cuboids/number-line/venn/algebra-grid/bar-model and its returned envelope; no baseHash. Does not edit, save a library, or store a booklet. Links expire after seven days; repeat with saved source to refresh. The linked archive is generated on download, so verify retrieval before claiming success. Oversized links may use bounded inline ZIP; otherwise use individual files. Legacy graph fonts require explicit revise_graph conversion first.

name: get_diagram_svg
description: Retrieve original outlined SVG content through MCP when external SVG downloads are blocked. Supply kind graph/ratio-table/value-graph/cuboids/number-line/venn/algebra-grid/bar-model and the exact returned envelope; no URL or baseHash. Venn outputView defaults pupil; answer must be explicitly requested. Does not revise or save a file. First call: omit offsetBytes; maxChunkBytes defaults to 49152 (1024..49152). Save decoded svgChunk as exact UTF-8 with no extra newline. For continuation use returned nextOffsetBytes and expectedSvgSha256:svgSha256, repeating source/outputView. Verify contiguous offsets, chunkBytes/chunkSha256, unchanged file metadata, then totalBytes/svgSha256 before embedding. sourceContentHash is the revision hash; svgSha256 is a different file checksum. complete means this is the last chunk, not that a client saved a file or printed a PDF. Do not redraw, normalize text, or substitute the preview. If exact saving fails, report the client limitation. Existing download links remain available.

name: ratio_table_capabilities
description: Read supported ratio-table cells, rows, sizes, limits and operations before creating a table. Lesson-style one-, two- or three-column diagrams. columns: 2 and rendererVersion: ratio-1 are legacy defaults, not limits; supportedColumns and rendererVersions list full support. Returned envelopes normalize to schemaVersion 1/ratio-1 for exactly two columns and at least two rows, otherwise schemaVersion 2/ratio-2. Adding/removing rows or columns can change the returned version; always reuse the returned envelope and contentHash. Two columns use paired outer scaling arrows; three columns show the operation beside each column.

rendererVersion.description: Legacy default renderer, not the only supported renderer. See rendererVersions; each returned envelope identifies its actual renderer.

columns.description: Legacy default column count, not a limit. See supportedColumns for all supported counts.

name: revise_algebra_grid
description: Atomically revise exact algebra-grid envelope with baseHash:contentHash and operations(max30). set_cell {rowId,columnId,value:string|null,hidden?}; set_settings {settings:{mode?,expression?,questionVisible?,gridVisible?,answerLines?,compactHeadings?,gridLineMm?,paper?,orientation?,intentionalError?}}; set_cell_size {cellMm:12..18} resets width overrides; set_column_width {columnId,widthMm:12..45}; add_row {},remove_row {},add_column {},remove_column {} append/remove last edge; fill_products {overwrite:false} requires true for occupied products; collect_answer {} needs complete products; calculate_answer {} supplies only final answer,preserving every pupil blank; worked_copy {} explicitly returns a worked variant; set_answer_visibility {visible}. Integer terms in x,powers0..6. Automatic factorising:monic quadratics3x3 or single-row common factors;other shapes need correct headings. Stable IDs come from returned envelope. Empty operations refresh links. Calculate only when explicitly requested. Returns preview,outlined SVG,600ppi PNG,JSON,native dimensions and editor link;hidden answers remain in editable source.

name: revise_bar_model
description: Explicit upgrade_document{targetSchemaVersion:3} upgrades v1/v2 to horizontal fractions and larger handwriting spaces; once FIRST, original hash checked before changes, later failure rolls back all. No target keeps prior v1→v2 meaning. V3 captions add format:maths|plain and set_presentation accepts minimum barHeightMm8..24. V2 operations add upgrade_document{} (exactly once FIRST on v1); set_section_label{barId,partId,slot:inside|above|below,label}; set_section_labels{barId,partIds,slot,label}; move_or_copy_label{from:{barId,partId,slot},to:{barId,partId,slot},mode:move|copy,overwrite?:false}; set_annotation{annotation}; remove_annotation{annotationId}; equal_sections{barId,count,discardContent?:false} preserves exact total; changed count replaces IDs and needs explicit discard for affected labels/fills/fixed anchors. set_fill{barId,partIds,fill}; add_caption/update_caption{caption}; remove_caption{captionId}; set_title{label:null|Label}; set_presentation{presentation,autoName?}; set_quantity_name{barId,label}; set_relative_length{barId,partId,weight}; append_section{barId,part,afterId?}; append_bar{bar,afterId?}; reorder_bars{barIds}. Refer to the complete emitted operation schema. Without explicit upgrade, legacy sources stay v1 and reject new features. A later failure rolls back the entire batch including upgrade. Retained hidden destinations require explicit overwrite. Between annotations must still attach to adjacent bars. Revise exact bar-model envelope with baseHash=contentHash and operations(max30,atomic). set_label {target:{barId,partId?}|{spanId},label:{text,state}}; set_part {barId,partId,weight?,shade?}; add_bar {bar,afterId?}; remove_bar {barId,discardSpans?:false}; add_part {barId,part,afterId?}; remove_part {barId,partId,discardSpans?:false}; add_span {span}; set_span {span} replaces exact identified span; remove_span {spanId}; set_alignment {barId,offset}; set_print {presentation:{unitMm?,barHeightMm?,fontPt?,nameWidthMm?}}; reveal_saved_answers {} only on explicit request. Use complete bar/part/span schemas from create_bar_model and stable returned IDs. Removal of referenced parts/bars requires discardSpans:true or prior explicit span removal; never reanchors. Label state changes preserve supplied saved text. No implicit maths, answer reveal or resizing from labels. Empty operations refresh files/links. Returns envelope/hash,preview,SVG,verified600ppiPNG,JSON,native dimensions,versions,print facts and warnings; editable files/links retain hidden answers.

name: revise_ratio_table
description: Revise the exact returned ratio-table envelope using its contentHash as baseHash. Operations are atomic. Each operation is an object with op and these fields: add_column {heading:{text,italic,direction}}; remove_column {column}; set_cell {rowId,column,cell}; add_row {after,row:{id,cells}}; remove_row {rowId}; set_transition {transition:{from,to,operation,factor}}; remove_transition {from}; set_headings {headings}; set_size {size}; set_annotation_visibility {mode?,showArrows?,showOperations?}; fill_next_row {from,overwrite?}. Example: {"op":"set_transition","transition":{"from":"start","to":"target","operation":"multiply","factor":"4"}}. Do not put transition fields at the operation top level. Numeric values/factors are strings; column indexes are zero-based; after is a row ID or null. Heading direction is right/up/none and italic is boolean. add_column appends the heading and empty cells. Keep blank/answer-line cells unless the user explicitly asks to fill them. fill_next_row requires a chosen transition and all source values; overwriting existing values requires overwrite true. Empty operations refresh expired links. Row/column changes normalize the result to schemaVersion 1/ratio-1 for exactly two columns and at least two rows, otherwise schemaVersion 2/ratio-2. Preserve unchanged values/settings, reuse the returned envelope/hash and show the returned image and links.

operations.description: Atomic operations with an op discriminator. set_transition requires a nested transition object, e.g. {"op":"set_transition","transition":{"from":"start","to":"target","operation":"multiply","factor":"4"}}. add_column requires heading:{text,italic,direction}; remove_column requires a zero-based column index. See the tool description for all operation payloads.

name: revise_value_graph
description: Atomically revise the exact returned envelope with its contentHash as baseHash. All numeric values are strings; references use stable IDs, not indexes. Operations: set_equation {equation:{a,b,c}}; set_cell {columnId,x?,y?}; insert_column {afterId,column:{id,x,y}}; remove_column {columnId}; replace_columns {columns}; calculate_cells {columnIds,overwrite:boolean}; set_graph {settings}; plot_series {id,source:table|equation,columnIds,connection:none|straight-joins}; put_series {series:{id,source,points:[{id,x,y,columnId?}],connection}}; remove_series {id}; set_connection {id,connection}; move_point {seriesId,pointId,x,y,linked:update-table|detach}; set_curve {curve:null|{id,equation:{a,b,c},min,max}}; set_reference_lines {lines:[{id,y}]}; set_presentation {settings}; set_print {settings}. calculate_cells alone supplies answers and requires overwrite:true to replace existing values. Equation edits retain cells/plots. plot_series source:table skips blank cells and includes zero; source:equation explicitly calculates points without filling the table. Empty operations refresh links. Preserve returned envelope/hash after every revision.

name: revise_venn
description: Revise Venn envelope/baseHash atomically (max30). set_region {mask,region}; set_label {set:universe|A|B|C,label}; set_definition {set,text}; set_definitions_visible {visible}; set_layout {sets?,shape?,arrangement?,caption?,discardIncompatible?}; shade_regions {masks,style:none|grey|hatch,mode:replace|add}; shade_expression {expression,style,mode}; clear_shading {}; set_print {widthCm?,fontPt?}; upgrade_document {}. Expressions use stable A/B/C IDs, union/intersection/complement and brackets. Lossy layout changes require the user's explicit discard request and discardIncompatible:true; never merge values. Legacy files need explicit upgrade for new layouts. outputView pupil|answer affects artwork only; retain returned pupil source/hash. Empty operations refresh links. Return a preview, SVG, verified 600 ppi PNG, editable JSON, contentHash, actual physicalSizeCm and an editor link where bounded. Preserve pupil blanks/hidden answers and retain the returned envelope/hash. Numeric mathematical values are strings. Never infer answers.
